messages.text: I’ll read the diff and check for missing behavior, validation gaps, and edge cases.
The API’s shared-field filtering and date-overlap query look consistent. I’m checking the browser’s recovery behavior and the database boundaries that the current tests do not exercise.

- Finding floor: 95,596 bytes ÷ 1,000 = 95.596 kB; N = min(floor(√95.596 + 1), 10) = **10**.
- [schedule.js:31](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/schedule.js:31): Room and date remain editable during a request. Changing either before the response arrives leaves the form showing new conditions while results—or field errors—belong to the previous conditions. Disable those controls during submission, or discard responses whose captured conditions no longer match.
- [home.html:30](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/templates/home.html:30): The form’s native action opens `/api/schedule`, so an unavailable or failed script takes users to raw JSON. Provide an HTML fallback using the shared service, or an explicit JavaScript-required message instead of exposing a misleadingly functional form.
- [home.html:47](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/templates/home.html:47): Expired-session recovery preserves conditions only until the user follows “重新登录后查询.” Login then returns to an empty form, losing the selected room and date. Carry those non-sensitive conditions through the login round trip.
- [schema.sql:37](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/schema.sql:37): Timestamp constraints accept values that `local_time()` cannot represent. Setting an intersecting record’s `end_at` to `253402300800` passes SQLite constraints but makes the entire schedule return 500. Define supported timestamp bounds and reject incompatible stored records before they reach DTO conversion.
- [web.py:75](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/web.py:75): Query parsing silently ignores repeated parameters. Both `room_id=10&room_id=bad` and `date=2026-11-12&date=bad` return 200 using the first value. Reject duplicate scalar parameters, or explicitly document and test their precedence so strict validation is unambiguous.
- [schedule.js:45](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/schedule.js:45): The new timeout and recovery implementation has no focused regression tests; the recorded JavaScript tests exercise only `auth.js`. Add schedule tests for stalled response headers, stalled response bodies, rejected fetches, and malformed JSON, checking that controls recover and a subsequent query succeeds.
- [verify_auth_browser.cjs:49](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.cjs:49): Schedule interactions use `click`, `fill`, and `selectOption`; only authentication is exercised with keyboard navigation. Add a keyboard-only room/date/query flow, including focus recovery after validation failure, to substantiate the new interface’s keyboard-accessibility claim.
- [verify_auth_browser.cjs:67](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.cjs:67): Browser assertions never check displayed status labels. The fixture uses fixed November 2026 dates while Waitress uses the real clock, so future reruns can show every record as ended and still pass. Add controlled browser cases for all three status labels and their association with the correct records.
- [verify_auth_browser.cjs:90](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.cjs:90): “Empty” browser coverage tests an empty schedule in an existing room, not an empty room directory. Add a no-rooms browser case that checks the explanatory message, disabled controls, absence of accidental requests, and continued logout operation.
- [home.html:30](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/templates/home.html:30): `novalidate` disables native validation, but the script adds no local checks for missing room/date or the date maximum. Even obviously incomplete input requires a server round trip. Add immediate field validation while retaining authoritative server validation, and test the date-error path—the current browser test only exercises the room error.
